4.name: About Us
4.content:
Arcooda is a arcade manufacturing company with 29 years experience in the arcade and amusement industry. We create unique and never-before-seen products for both home and commercial applications. Our experience lies in building successful relationships with arcade and amusement manufacturers and suppliers, establishing efficient distribution networks, consultancy services for amusement and arcade locations as well as developing inventive products that are new to the arcade and amusement industry.

Our focus is on the customer and providing the highest quality products in the marketplace, we treat home and commercial customers the same, no matter how large or small their needs are. We encourage customer feedback on all products so we can continuously improve and update our machines. We aim to build ongoing and close relationships with all clients to ensure that our customers receive high calibre service and product for their application. We never disclose who we sell to, or who we help, and offer full confidentiality. Use our knowledge to enhance your arcade experience.

Why choose Arcooda?

  • All customers are important, no matter how small or large their needs may be
  • New and never-before-seen products offered
  • Extensive knowledge on all machines within our product range
  • Excellent pricing on all products
  • Full after-sales service offering full backup service and support
  • Continuous improvement and development on all products based on customer feedback
  • First-rate delivery services
  • Worldwide exposure and experience
  • Consultancy and development services available
  • We can provide third party shipments to your customers with total confidentiality using your sales invoices
